name: catalog/daily_check_alert
description: The invariants run (sweep, every 10 minutes) found an alert the daily cost check wrote in the last 24 hours: a ledger above the bill, an unlabelled or unpriced resource, or a 7-day batch success rate under target (M6-F1-R10, M6 decision S6-8).
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=~"^catalog-" AND jsonPayload.message="invariant" AND jsonPayload.id="daily_check_alert" AND jsonPayload.violations>0
